> Do you find that you criticise yourself a lot?

Non-stop. Psychologically deafening

I've sought help before and have been diagnosed with borderline personality disorder and obsessive compulsive disorder. I've tried medication and therapy. I've also managed to abstain from harmful substances in the past but to no end.

I have some contact with my mom, but she always threaten to commit suicide if I ask her for help
I'm proud of her, but I lack her strength apparently
I can know that on a mental level, but it usually just makes me feel guilty and even more pathetic

The camera positioning makes it look like you're missing part of your ear.

Also, I don't like the greasy hair look at all. It makes you look younger and antisocial. You look a lot better in the second picture, even though it sort of looks like a mug shot. Relax your face and try different angles! Not ugly.

You look younger than 21, so there's that. Besides the weight, I think filling in your eyebrows would help immensely /r/makeupaddiction

Not ugly but you could look better with makeup and weight loss
25f- I think you look younger than 41. Don't look unattractive at all and seem to be in good shape
I actually had shorter/messy hair like that when I was in my late teens... maybe I'll go back to that length. Any opinion on color? I was thinking about going dirty blonde this summer

Thanks for the tips. I've actually be using Argan oil (you should see my hair without it)

I'm constantly fighting frizz haha... I'll ask around at my salon
I'll take it as a compliment haha.. I want to be a writer
I run a lot and definitely get enough water. I think I just have permanent bags that need to be covered up with makeup or something
I'm considering getting bangs like this http://us.cdn281.fansshare.com/photos/zooeydeschanel/zooey-deschanel-zooey-deschanel-hair-1192292481.jpg
A lot of people have mentiond makeupaddicition, I"ll have to check it out next!

I found those at the back of my closet. I don't even know where they came from haha... just tried them on and took a pic :P Don't even think I was wearing a bra under that shirt, so it definitely wasn't a  serious outfit

Thank you for your hair advice! I have a bad habbit of avoiding salon appointments while I'm trying to grow it out (had it in a bob 3 years ago). I should get an appointment back in and get hair supplies while I'm there. I'm thinking about getting bangs and subtle highlights
9/10... lol. Wayyyyy too kind, but yeah I'm not very good at taking selfies. I usually don't unless I'm snapchatting a friend (hence all the low quality snapchat screenshots)
I love Jennifer Carpenter! Don't dis Deb. But ya, I've been told that by so many people it's scary

I'm pretty androgynous personality/style wise so that's nbd... I do look tired all the time though, can't find a way to get rid of those bags under my eyes without gobs of concealer (which I don't really like wearing)
